items.q: He was the arranger and conductor. And in this recording there are several compositions which were collaborations between him and me.

ctx.x: Drum Fever. He was the arranger and conductor. And in this recording there are several compositions which were collaborations between him and me. This, this recording belongs to me. That recording is called Drum Fever. Very good indeed, very good indeed. There are several different arrangers and musicians also, according to the type of music to be recorded. That was how they chose the musicians - according to the type of music - someone who had experience in that particular music.
